page_title: OSA 1-1 ELC | Osasuna v Elche 25/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+2' The attendance is 19475.
90+2' 1 - 1 Goal! Adria Pedrosa (Elche) seizes on the loose ball after a huge error from Sergio Herrera and finds the back of the net from inside the box. 1:1.
90+1' Adria Pedrosa (Elche) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Elche.
88' The resulting set piece from Elche is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
86' Alessio Lisci prepares a substitution. Moi Gomez is replaced by Kike Barja (Osasuna).
85' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Adria Pedrosa (Elche) was quite harsh and Adrian Cordero didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
84' The referee allows time for a substitution. Alvaro Nunez will be replaced by Josan (Elche).
84' The referee blows his whistle after Rafa Mir (Elche) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball. Osasuna will take a free kick.

81' A brilliant individual effort! Raul Garcia (Osasuna) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Elche.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ante Budimir leaves the pitch and Raul Garcia (Osasuna) comes on.
79' 40:60 – this is the current ball possession ratio.

77' Rafa Mir (Elche) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Adrian Cordero blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. It's a free kick to Osasuna in a dangerous position.
76' Elche are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.

73' Alvaro Nunez (Elche) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Sergio Herrera shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
73' Good work from Elche as they win a corner.
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sheraldo Becker (Osasuna) will replace Victor Munoz.
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Juan Cruz (Osasuna) is coming onto the pitch as Iker Benito cannot continue after picking up an injury.
70' Eder Sarabia is stunned as referee Adrian Cordero shows him a RED CARD.
69' Eder Sarabia decides to make a substitution. Hector Fort will be replaced by Adria Pedrosa (Elche).
69' Substitution. Grady Diangana did his best and is replaced by German Valera (Elche).
68' A long pass finds Hector Fort (Elche), and he decides to test the keeper from long range. The shot flies towards the bottom right corner, but Sergio Herrera reacts well to make a good save.
66' Iker Benito (Osasuna) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Victor Munoz.
65' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
62' A loose pass is instantly latched onto by Rafa Mir (Elche). He tries his luck from the edge of the box with a measured shot, but it hits the crossbar and is cleared to safety.
61' Rafa Mir (Elche) probably handled the ball.
60' Iker Benito (Osasuna) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
57' Adrian Cordero blows his whistle after Ante Budimir (Osasuna) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
56' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

56' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his daisy-cutter towards the right post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it.
55' Here is a change. Andre Silva is going off and Eder Sarabia gives the last tactical orders to Rafa Mir (Elche).
55' Grady Diangana (Elche) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
53' Good defending. Alvaro Nunez (Elche) tries to find Andre Silva inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
52' Adrian Cordero blows his whistle for a foul after Moi Gomez (Osasuna) hacks down one of his opponents.
50' Hector Fort (Elche) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.

49' Hector Fort (Elche) weaves through the defence with ease and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score with his low strike to the middle of the target as Sergio Herrera produces a good save.
48' A spell of possession for Elche in an attempt to control the game.
47' Hector Fort (Elche) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
46' We are about to witness a subsitution. David Affengruber (Elche) for Bambo Diaby.
46' The whistle blows and Adrian Cordero starts the second half.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+6' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the right post.
45+4' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
45+1' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but powers his header just wide of the left post.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' That's a clear yellow card. Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) goes into the book.
44' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) brings his opponent down. Adrian Cordero has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
42' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
41' Bambo Diaby (Elche) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Adrian Cordero who sees an offensive foul.
39' A pass by Andre Silva (Elche) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
39' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 10:4.
38' The players claim that Ante Budimir (Osasuna) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
36' A cross from Grady Diangana (Elche) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
34' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) whips the ball into the box and Victor Munoz takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept. It's a throw-in for Elche.
33' Osasuna have a goal-scoring opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
32' Victor Chust (Elche) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
31' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Osasuna comes to nothing.
30' Iker Benito (Osasuna) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Corner kick. Osasuna will have an opportunity.
29' What was Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
28' Moi Gomez receives a sweet cross inside the box from Ante Budimir (Osasuna), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
27' The free kick from long range, taken by Elche, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
26' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) tackles a bit over-zealously and Adrian Cordero blows for a foul. Elche win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
25' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) finds Victor Munoz with a nice pass so he can go on towards the goal.
22' A player from Osasuna commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.

22' Inaki Pena makes a brilliant save! Victor Munoz (Osasuna) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the right side of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
20' A crossfield pass from Iker Benito (Osasuna) fails to find any of his teammates.
19' The foul by Moi Gomez (Osasuna) was seen by Adrian Cordero who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
18' Grady Diangana (Elche) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
16' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) gets on the end of the free kick, but somehow sends his header high over the bar from close in.

15' Leo Petrot (Elche) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Osasuna earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
15' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
14' The linesman signals a throw-in for Elche.
13' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

10' 1 - 0 Goal! Victor Munoz (Osasuna) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the top right corner. Inaki Pena had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:0.
8' Adrian Cordero blows his whistle after Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
7' Adrian Cordero interrupts the game. One of the players from Osasuna won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
6' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
4' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
3' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
2' The Elche players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.

Inaki Pena doesn't have to worry about that one. Iker Benito puts a cross in towards Lucas Torro (Osasuna), who is unable to keep his header on target from the centre of the box. He sends the ball well wide of the right post.
The players are on the pitch and Elche will have the kick-off.
Adrian Cordero is the one to supervise the game today.
